continuation: This execution was continued after interruptions: two context compactions and one session usage limit. Each time it resumed from OUT\work\progress.json. After the last resumption the generator and checker were re-run in full, so every figure below comes from that final run.
sources: the 117 in-tree landed outputs listed in dan_landed_outputs_manifest.v1.json, each opened by script at its listed path and digest-checked; the 20 final_message files and the 4 out-of-tree files in that manifest were never opened

changed.why: Generator for the Daniel scholar-facing record (close-gate item 20), ported from Ezekiel's for form. It takes --dan-root, --out-root and --check, verifies 22 pinned input digests, opens landed files only by their manifest paths, and scans no directory. It uses no clock and no randomness.

The generated record, in ten sections. It covers 75 units: 64 dispute entries (1 high, 16 medium, 47 low) and 11 quiet units. It carries 46 open questions, each marked open, a provenance table naming all 141 manifest outputs, the licence section with its stated limit, the substitution table (178 rows) and the 90 frame templates.

Checker with 15 tests. They cover byte-identical regeneration, line endings, section order, unit placement, every raised passage having an entry, every landed packet represented, every high-severity finding present, every cross-reading disagreement surfaced, evidence on each side plus a resolution, and the 46 open questions present as open. Three more trace every quoted line to a landed or pinned string, match every other line to a printed template, and apply the 21-pattern vocabulary blocklist with positive controls. The last two confirm the substitution and template lists and the licence section with its limit.
Check record written by the checker: VERDICT PASS, 15 of 15.
What was ported from Ezekiel, what changed for Daniel and why, every packet class with its count, and every limit. Its counts are copied by script from the check record.
Cursor updated: all five units done.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The licence terms in section 8 are carried from the Ezekiel record's wording, because Daniel's files contain only attribution markers and the strategy's rule that quotations carry their attribution. Nobody in this build checked the upstream licences.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The record's licence paragraph is REPORTED from another book's record, not established from Daniel's bytes. The document says so beside it, and the owner may want the terms confirmed at source before publication.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The installed re-run with default arguments from ...\Dan\scholar_record was not made, because this build may not write in the tree.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: Identical bytes after installation are INFERRED from the scripts embedding no path, clock or random value. The orchestrator's --check run is the measurement.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The audit's overall verdict is RETURN, with two conditions it could not test; a supplementary audit later met both at an inferred grade. The record states this plainly.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The scholar record reports an audit that did not simply pass; item 20 passing its checker does not change that.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: All readings, re-readings, adjudication and audit ran on one model family.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: Agreement between readings is one voice (OW-19); the record says so in section 2.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: The substitution table is measured against the blocklist, not proven complete. Still in quoted sentences are lowercase short codes (s4, s5, x1, w9, w16 and similar, 66 occurrences), upper-case verdict words (FINDING, SUPPORT, CHECKED) and ordinary words such as bytes, run, script, record, pinned, scan, digest and model. The blocklist covers only the body before the provenance section, and the licence quotations in section 8 are left unsubstituted and name two working files.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: A scholar reading the record will still meet some project residue. Mechanical replacement of rule codes and note numbers also loses which one was meant.
